info.author: Sunwook Kim
info.name: django-dynamic-contents
info.summary: A Django library for creating and managing dynamic, customizable content structures with ease. Designed to enhance multilingual support in Django applications, it facilitates the creation of HTML or text content that can be easily translated into multiple languages, offering a flexible solution for integrating varied content parts.
